topic: Get 3 new Google reviews this week: who to ask and how
caption:
Three reviews this week is not a big ask.
Pick three customers you helped recently. Text them directly. Paste your Google review link right in the message.
Don't make them hunt for it or they won't do it.
Want to know how to find your review link fast? DM us REVIEWS.
